constraints.description: The built core root and optional ./devtools runtime exports must exactly match the committed skills ledger, while declaration-only controller time-travel types remain documented as types.

validation.validation_method: Build through the assembled gate, then run node scripts/verify-skills-exports.mjs --pkg core.

constraints.description: Public content must match controller ownership, complete capture, stable expiry, rewind/live, branching, import, teardown, and deprecated facade semantics in production source.

validation.validation_method: Compare README and skills/API references with protocol.ts, controller.ts, time-travel.ts, the compatibility bridge, and the accepted specification.

constraints.description: The security receipt must state local full-value snapshot sensitivity, metadata-only serialization, rewind/import mutation authority, untrusted import validation, store isolation, and host transport responsibility.

validation.validation_method: Inspect the security receipt against snapshot retention, command parsing, restore boundaries, controller lifecycle, and serialized receipts/events.

constraints.description: Every fixture, package, consumer, and scenario status must pass; TypeScript, Flutter, and packed fixtures must be byte-identical at the recorded SHA-256.

validation.validation_method: Run pnpm run verify:devtools-time-travel, recursively reject non-pass statuses, compare both source fixtures, and match the receipt hash.

constraints.description: Time-travel readiness must not be presented as completion of React/Flutter inspector surfaces, extensions, site, release certification, or publication.

validation.validation_method: Require explicit downstream exclusions in the skills reference, verification receipt, and QA report.

global_rules: Refinement may correct documentation or observed implementation defects but may not broaden production scope.
Only the completed assembled packed-consumer gate counts as behavioral evidence.
Do not create or run unit, component, isolated, mock-backed, snapshot, or partial tests.
Do not imply package publication or full DevTools product certification.
termination_conditions: All five blocking constraints are satisfied.
The ledger, packed receipt, and cross-runtime fixture validator pass.
No further delta improves truthfulness, security clarity, or traceability.
